description: Use this to discover which EU instruments are held before a coverage question, or find their registry ids and legal status. Paginated, filterable by status, category, core/supplementary, and by whether an instrument was in force on a given date. For corpus-coverage questions, filter by category here, enumerate each instrument with list_provisions, then open what you need with get_provision.

in_force_on_date.description: ISO date; keeps instruments in force on that date.

status.description: Legal status at the release, e.g. "in_force".

name: list_instruments

celex.description: The CELEX of the text served; null where that text has none, as for a Council document.

proposal_celex.description: The Commission proposal's CELEX where the instrument began as one. It identifies the proposal, not the text served, unless the text served is the proposal.

source_document.description: The document the served text is taken from, as its provenance records it; null where none is recorded.

text_state.description: `consolidated`: a EUR-Lex consolidation. `as_adopted`: an enacted act's own text, amendments not incorporated. `council_position_text`: the text of the position the Council adopted at first reading, which is not law. `proposal_text`: a Commission proposal's text, which is not law. Not a legal status; see `legal_status_at_release`.

title: Discover held EU legislation
